title: ‘Panic Selling’ Today: Yields To 8%, Gold To $3,100, What Happens To Stocks? | Chris Vermeulen
speaker: Chris Vermeulen (TheTechnicalTraders.com)

macro_themes.view: Multi-year bull flags on 5/10/30-year yields point to 6.5% then 8% on the 10y, which would trigger a global financial crisis and an eventual stock market top.

macro_themes.theme: Equities still the place to be
macro_themes.view: Stage-three topping/sector rotation with weak breadth, but tech, Mags and semis still bullish; panic selling signals a 1-3 day bottom.
Higher yields and safe-haven flows push the dollar much higher; USD/CAD could reach 1.73.

macro_themes.theme: Precious metals in stage-four bear market
macro_themes.view: Gold and silver have rolled over; rising yields, strong dollar and margin calls could force a sharp flush.

calls.reason: Monthly bull flag breaking out above the 150-period MA; Fibonacci extensions give 6.5% as first target and 8% as the second.
calls.quote: It is pointing to potentially 6 and 1 half yield as the first level all the way up to 8%

calls.reason: Same bull-flag-and-pullback pattern as the 10-year, pointing to a significant previous high.
calls.quote: if we go look at the 30-year... We've got the same bull flag pattern and pullback.

calls.reason: Bond prices are in a major bear market and starting a huge drop; do not hold bonds for price.
calls.quote: if you're looking at bond prices themselves, they're in a major bare market. You don't want to hold bonds

calls.reason: Monthly chart channeling higher in a pattern like prior run-ups; higher yields and safe-haven demand pull capital to the dollar; could rise 14-16%.
calls.quote: I believe we are going to see the dollar push higher... I see it going back up to a$120

calls.condition: Suggested stop roughly 5% below, under recent lows
calls.reason: Panic-selling indicator spiked above 3 (usually a bottom within 1-3 days); bull flags and a 61.8% Fib pause point to an easy 3-5% pop this week and ~15% to 35,100.
calls.quote: there's a I think an easy 3, four, 5% move to the upside... by the end of this week

calls.condition: Major top risk if 10y yield pushes over 6-6.5%
calls.reason: Long equities; panic selling marks a short-term cycle low and the trend is still up, though yields above ~6-6.5% could put in a major top.
calls.quote: we're long the equities market... tomorrow, we should probably see the market rebound and start to run up

calls.reason: 150-day MA turned down: stage-four bear market like 2011-13; target ~3,100 where he would re-accumulate for the next long-term bull.
calls.quote: I have the downside move for for gold is about 3,100 uh an ounce if this pattern is to play out

calls.reason: Silver is in the same stage-four downtrend as gold.
calls.quote: Silver's doing doing the exact same thing. You don't want to hold an asset that is moving lower

calls.reason: Turned from bearish to bullish above the long-term MA; paused at the 61.8% Fib, so a 100% measured move of ~13% to 94,500, possibly within 2-3 days.
calls.quote: it's got about a 13% move up to 94,500

notes: Host states Monday September 28. S&P 500 level 7,677 quoted by host. NQ 35,100 target is ~15% above; current NQ level not stated. Also bearish CAD (USD/CAD to 1.73), not recorded as a call.
